name: NCO device, flight cap (Cadet Airman / NCO)
size_basis: Diameter 1.25 in, estimated: no dimension is printed anywhere. On the Attachment 5 flight-cap figure (p.139) the disc is the same width as the officer flight device (which Vanguard prints at 1 1/4 in), so it is drawn at 1.25 in. (An earlier build drew a disc of 1.3 in whose rim was clipped to a square by a scale bug)
provenance: CAPR 39-1 3 Mar 2020 Fig A5-8 (p.138, CAP DEVICES row and the devices as drawn on the caps; A5-9 shows the same devices on the women's caps) "Cadet Airman and NCO flight cap": wings and propeller traced from the 10x render (mirror-averaged), rim / field built as true circles, field 0.818 of the outside diameter, colours sampled

mounts.uniform: USAF-style flight cap (Class A / Class B / FDU)
mounts.rule: front left flap, centred halfway between the top and bottom of the flap, 1 1/2 in back from the front of the cap (6.2.2.2.3; Senior Member NCOs per ICL 25-02 (g))
Senior Member NCOs wear the NCO device centred on the front of the cap (6.2.1.1.1 as changed by ICL 25-02)

documented: cadet NCOs and Airmen wear the metal Cadet Airman flight cap insignia (6.2.2.2.3)
Senior Member NCOs wear the NCO device (ICL 25-02 (g), Fig A5-8/9)
